description.en: Custom-provider enhancements for DeepSeek Harness: per-provider request User-Agent override and reasoning-level switching (Off / Low / Medium / High / Max) auto-filled for hand-declared models, managed from a native Settings section.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 自定义供应方增强：按供应方的请求 User-Agent 覆盖，以及为手动声明模型自动补全的推理等级切换（Off / Low / Medium / High / Max），在原生设置页统一管理。
